method: PLS on the whole spectrum, then distance-based LDA on the PLS scores (PLS-LDA); classes = country of origin (4)
source: Tapp HS, Defernez M, Kemsley EK (2003) FTIR spectroscopy and multivariate analysis can distinguish the geographic origin of extra virgin olive oils. J Agric Food Chem 51(21):6110-6115, doi:10.1021/jf030232s, abstract

protocol.known: cross-validation success rate; duplicate spectra of 60 oils
protocol.unknown: number of PLS components, preprocessing, whether both duplicates of an oil were left out together

tolerance.note: Loose check because the protocol is not known in detail. Sanity check (PROVENANCE.md): leave-one-oil-out PLS-LDA gave 0.88-0.93 for 5-15 components, so the 0.90 floor holds only for some component counts under grouped CV; Quan to confirm the floor and the protocol it applies to.

notes: ga_lda_cv_accuracy_published (GA variable selection, 8 variates, then LDA) is recorded for completeness; it is not a planned reference test.
Cross-validation must keep both spectra of one oil (same 'oil' id, loader 'groups') in the same fold, otherwise the duplicate leaks into training.
